entries.rationale: Not affected in Debian Bookworm: the vulnerable MiniZip code is not built into this zlib binary package, as recorded by Debian. The watchdog does not expose a MiniZip API.
Not reachable in the reviewed runtime: the fixed entrypoint executes Node and flock only; it never invokes Perl or compiles attacker-controlled Perl regular expressions.
Not reachable in the reviewed runtime: the watchdog never invokes Perl Archive::Tar and accepts no archive uploads or archive-extraction inputs.
Not applicable to this linux/amd64 image because the vulnerability requires a 32-bit Perl build; the reviewed runtime is x64 and does not invoke Perl.
Not reachable in the reviewed runtime: this issue is in the infocmp CLI, which the Node-and-flock entrypoint never invokes; no terminal database input is accepted.

Not applicable to this container: systemd-homed is not running, there are no homed-managed interactive users, and the process runs as the non-root node user.

Not reachable in the reviewed runtime: the watchdog never invokes gzip and accepts no compressed-file or archive input; request bodies are bounded JSON only.

Not reachable in the reviewed runtime: the watchdog never invokes Perl IO::Compress or passes attacker-controlled output globs to Perl.
